He read it twice beside the lamp room, then climbed the spiral stairs with the letter pressed to his chest. All morning the sea flashed like broken glass. Some messages, he decided, do not arrive late; they wait until someone is finally lonely enough to listen, brave enough to carry them, and foolish enough to believe forgiveness can still cross water.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像被潮水退回的贝壳，安静得能听见红绿灯变换。高楼的玻璃还含着夜色，便利店的白光落在空荡路口。环卫车慢慢驶过，水花把霓虹推成模糊的河。有人结束夜班，有人刚刚开始熬粥；天桥下猫缩成一团，风从地铁口吹出温热的气息。此刻没有白天的辩解，也没有黄昏的告别，只有未眠的窗、未寄出的消息，和天边一线将亮未亮的蓝。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem is solved by breaking it into a smaller copy of itself.\n- The smaller copy is solved the same way, again and again, until it becomes tiny and easy.\n- Then the easy answers are stacked back together to solve the original problem."}
